inputs.text: The IOC has made exclusion the policy: transgender women and DSD athletes will be barred from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Calling this “fairness and safety” does not make it neutral; it casts already marginalized athletes as a problem to be managed, while the message offers no supporting detail for that justification. Kirsty Coventry’s claim that “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category” reduces a complex question of eligibility to a sweeping label. This is an institutional decision about who is allowed to participate—and its burden falls on trans and DSD athletes.
